annotations.title: Send a note to my members

description: Use this when a Phorme coach has written a short note to everyone training under one of their published coaching brains and clearly said to send it. It sends the coach's words as they are, as a notification and in each member's coach history: up to 400 characters, no links, one note per brain per day. It needs a connected Phorme account with an active coach plan that owns the brain.

confirmation.description: True only after the coach confirmed this exact note.

text.description: The coach's own words, exactly as they approved them.

name: send_note_to_my_members
title: Send a note to my members
